nginx.versionsNewScript: Invoke-WebRequest https://nginx.org/download/ | Select-Object -Property Content | % { $_ -split "`n" } | % { if ($_ -match '>nginx-(\d+\.\d+\.\d+).tar\.gz<') { $matches[1] } } | Sort-Object { [version]$_ } -Descending | ? { [version]$_ -ge [version]'1.23' -and [version]$_ -lt [version]'1.29' }
